name: star-forge
description: A Codex-native software factory that interviews, plans, builds, verifies, reviews, and delivers complete software.

interface.shortDescription: Interview, plan, build, verify, review, and deliver software through one Forge Loop.
interface.longDescription: Star Forge is a lean Codex-native software factory. One Forge Loop turns an objective into an approved Blueprint, routes work through the most specific available capabilities, coordinates task-scoped builders, records source-bound verification, runs adaptive review, and satisfies an explicit delivery contract. Existing projects can be resumed safely, while post-completion changes reopen only their affected scope. Hook ledgers remain diagnostic rather than trusted completion witnesses.
